_readme: Vendor reference photographs for scripts/autoboard/projects/651-belmont.json, one entry per imageKey. URLs only: the image files are third-party vendor product photography, fetched into the library root for internal design reference and deliberately NOT committed to this repository. Every URL here was downloaded and looked at before it was recorded — wrong-finish, watermarked, annotated, placeholder and wrong-format shots were rejected, so an empty `files` list means no usable photo is published, not that nobody looked. `sha256` is the digest of the reviewed file (absent where the host re-encodes per request — see digestUnstable); scaffold-project.mjs --fetch-images reports when a vendor has re-published an asset since. Re-verify before reusing these for anything a client sees.
